newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Bufete raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bufete raised to buy.

text.p: - Flemings Research said that it had raised its rating on Mexican construction firm Bufete Industrial, S.A. to a buy from a speculative buy.
- Flemings said that Bufete may be entering a new phase of its business development that deserves some kind of long-term reappraisal by the investment community.

- "In particular, a reactivation of the power segment in Mexico may be imminent, stimulated by the successful project financing for the Samalayuca II thermoelectric plant and recent regulatory changes in the storage, transportation, and distribution of natural gas."
- In October, Robert Flemings raised its rating on Bufete to the speculative buy from hold.
